summary.en: An inner if runs only on its enclosing path.
summary.bn: বড় শর্তের ভেতরে ছোট শর্ত দেখো, তিন সংখ্যার বড়টি বের করো এবং leap year-এর ব্যতিক্রম বোঝো।

notes: Nested if statements use the same grammar as ordinary if statements in C89 through C23. The leap-year calculation is a Gregorian calendar rule rather than a feature of the C standard. All running examples use C17.

examples.title: Check two dependent requirements
examples.explanationHtml: Registration is true, so control reaches the mark question. Sixty-five passes, selecting Eligible. The inner false message and outer false message belong to different paths. Explicit braces keep their ownership clear.

examples.title: Largest of three including a tie
examples.explanationHtml: The a-versus-b comparison accepts equality and chooses the a/c pair. Nine exceeds four, so best receives nine. Every possible branch assigns best before the final print. The code finds a maximum value without claiming a unique winning variable.

examples.title: A century exception
examples.explanationHtml: Nineteen hundred passes the four-year test but is a century year. It fails the four-hundred test, leaving leap at zero. The initialized flag covers all paths that do not explicitly set it to one.

practice.title: Two requirements
practice.statementHtml: Read registered 0 or 1 and mark 0 to 100. After the prompt Input: , print Eligible only when registered and mark at least 40, otherwise No; end the line.
hints: A combined condition can replace a true-only nested chain.

practice.title: Largest pair then third
practice.statementHtml: Read a, b and c from -100 to 100. After the prompt Input: , print their maximum and newline.
hints: A running maximum also handles ties.

practice.title: Explain eligibility
practice.statementHtml: Read registered 0 or 1 and mark 0 to 100. After the prompt Input: , print Unregistered, Low mark or Eligible according to the nested example; end the line.
hints: Different failed levels need different messages.

practice.title: Gregorian leap flag
practice.statementHtml: Read year 1 to 9999. After the prompt Input: , print 1 for a Gregorian leap year, otherwise 0; end with newline.
hints: Treat the century rule as an exception inside the four-year rule.

quiz.prompt: When can an inner if be reached?
quiz.explanation: The outer decision controls entry to the inner decision.

quiz.prompt: What is a useful way to trace nested decisions?
options: Draw each condition as a branch in a tree
quiz.explanation: A path shows which questions actually execute.

quiz.prompt: How should largest-of-three code handle equal maxima?
options: Still assign the shared maximum value
quiz.explanation: A maximum value exists even without a unique winner.

quiz.prompt: Is every year divisible by four a Gregorian leap year?
quiz.explanation: Centuries must also be divisible by four hundred.

quiz.prompt: Which century is leap in the Gregorian rule?
quiz.explanation: Two thousand is divisible by four hundred.

quiz.prompt: When can nested true-only checks become one AND condition?
options: When every failure needs a different message
When only the all-true path needs an action
quiz.explanation: AND preserves the required all-true selection.

quiz.prompt: What can reduce deeply indented validation code?
quiz.explanation: After rejecting invalid cases, the normal path can stay flatter.

quiz.prompt: Which value wins a tie for largest-of-three numeric output?
quiz.explanation: The tied maximum value remains nine.

quiz.prompt: Does the century 2000 pass the four-hundred leap rule?
quiz.explanation: Its divisibility by four hundred satisfies the exception.

quiz.prompt: A false outer condition skips the inner output. Which line remains?
quiz.explanation: The outer false path bypasses the entire inner decision.

keyPoints.en: An inner if runs only on its enclosing path.
keyPoints.bn: বাইরের পথ বেছে নিলে তবেই ভেতরের if দেখা হয়।
braces দিয়ে nesting-এর প্রতিটি স্তর বোঝাও।
তিন সংখ্যার বড়টি বের করতে সমান মানের ঘটনাও ধরো।

keyPoints.en: Century leap years require divisibility by 400.
keyPoints.bn: শতাব্দীর বছর leap হতে ৪০০ দিয়ে ভাগ যেতে হয়।

keyPoints.en: Logical AND can flatten a true-only chain.
keyPoints.bn: শুধু সব সত্য হলে কাজ চাইলে && দিয়ে nesting কমানো যায়।

examQuestions.question: When can an inner if be reached?
examQuestions.answerHtml: Only through its enclosing branch. The outer decision controls entry to the inner decision.

examQuestions.question: Read year 1 to 9999. After Input: print 1 for a Gregorian leap year, otherwise 0; end with newline.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
#include <stdio.h>

int main(void)
{
    int year;
    printf("Input: ");
    if (scanf("%d", &year) != 1 || year < 1 || year > 9999) {
        return 1;
    }
    int leap = 0;
    if (year % 4 == 0) {
        if (year % 100 != 0) {
            leap = 1;
        } else {
            if (year % 400 == 0) {
                leap = 1;
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", leap);
    return 0;
}

Treat the century rule as an exception inside the four-year rule.
